messages:
marta: Quick sync: partner wants a single-run playbook for Snowflake -> Databricks -> vector DB connector certification. Need an owner and minimum acceptance tests.
devon: Owner volunteer: I'll take certification checklist and the marketplace packaging bits.
kai: I'll own infra sandbox and the terraform recipe. Will we do per-region artifacts? Partner asked for us-east-1 + eu-west-1.
marta: Yes, start with both. Minimum acceptance tests: 1) schema compatibility (nullable/array fields) 2) end-to-end ingest (500 rows) 3) embedding delta stability after model swap 4) query recall >=0.9 for top-5. Keep tests fast.
devon: I'll draft pytest tests under tests/integration/partner_cert that output JUnit. Include small sample CSV and expected vectors.
kai: Infra plan: short-lived sandbox with shared egress IP, a Snowflake dev role, a DBX workspace token, and a single-node vector (qdrant) helm chart. Will add IAM role mapping for cross-account Snowflake access. ETA 72h.
marta: Ops requirement: KMS key in partner region + audit log forwarding. Partner needs SOC2-friendly artifacts for marketplace listing.
devon: Marketplace listing checklist: icon + one-sentence summary + deployment recipe + support matrix (SLA, contact). I'll draft.
ops-bot: sandbox-provision queued by kai -> ticket SBX-7891 scheduled for 2024-08-02T14:00Z
kai: I'll also include a small troubleshooting section: common failures (permission denied, schema mismatch, large VARCHAR truncation) and quick fixes.
marta: Action items: devon: tests + marketplace draft (due Mon). kai: infra + terraform (due Mon). marta: compile runbook and legal notes for data residency (due Tue). Quick check-in Monday 09:30 PT.
devon: noted. cc: @partner-success when ready for handoff. :thumbsup:
